domain: Religious Studies / Collective Memory / Ritual Practice
topic_summary: Analysis of Jewish catastrophe-commemoration rituals (Tisha B'Av, Passover) as contested kernels of mourning-practice preservation. The domain question: does millennia-long ritual transmission preserve survival-competence (adaptive capacity under persecution) or only mourning-practice itself (symbolic continuity without operational yield)?

key_entities: Tisha B'Av (annual fast commemorating Temple destructions, 586 BCE and 70 CE)
Passover (annual festival commemorating Exodus from Egypt, ~1300 BCE claimed)
Rabbinic Authority (interpretive tradition stabilizing ritual practice post-Temple)
Diaspora Communities (geographically dispersed populations maintaining synchronized practice)
Halakhic Corpus (legal framework encoding ritual obligations)
Historical Catastrophe Events (Temple destructions, expulsions, pogroms, Shoah)
key_tensions: Ritual fidelity vs adaptive modification (fixed practice vs contextual survival needs)
Mourning-as-identity vs mourning-as-preparation (symbolic continuity vs operational readiness)

commitment_system_recognition.kernel_description: Obligation to transmit catastrophe-memory through fixed ritual practice across generations
commitment_system_recognition.authority_description: Rabbinic interpretive tradition grounded in Talmudic precedent and halakhic continuity

readings.commitment: Ritual preserves identity-marker and mourning-practice; survival-competence is incidental byproduct
readings.authority_grounding: Formalist halakhic tradition; ritual obligation as intrinsic value independent of outcomes
readings.expected_structural_delta: High ritual fidelity; mourning-practice itself is the preserved substrate; victim set = communities that lose practice under assimilation pressure; beneficiary = ritual authority maintaining interpretive control

readings.commitment: Ritual transmits survival-competence through catastrophe-rehearsal and threat-recognition training
readings.authority_grounding: Functionalist reading; ritual as adaptive mechanism encoding persecution-response patterns
readings.expected_structural_delta: Ritual content selected for operational yield; mourning-practice is vehicle for competence transmission; victim set = communities that maintain ritual without extracting survival lessons; beneficiary = populations that convert ritual knowledge into adaptive capacity

readings.commitment: Ritual preserves both identity-continuity AND adaptive capacity through dual-function encoding
readings.authority_grounding: Pluralist synthesis; ritual as multi-layered transmission system
readings.expected_structural_delta: Ritual structure optimizes for both symbolic fidelity and operational readiness; mourning-practice and survival-competence co-evolve; victim set = communities that collapse either dimension; beneficiary = populations maintaining both functions in tension

axiom_contradictions.basis: Symbolic reading treats survival-competence as epiphenomenal (ritual value is intrinsic); adaptive reading treats symbolic continuity as instrumental (ritual value derives from operational yield). No single framework holds both: either ritual obligation is grounded in divine command independent of outcomes, or it is grounded in adaptive function. Hybrid reading attempts synthesis but does not resolve the foundational axiom conflict.

axes.structural_delta: Ritual obligation to transmit catastrophe-memory across generations; contested whether transmission preserves survival-competence or only mourning-practice
axes.primary_observable: Ritual participation rates; intergenerational transmission fidelity; correlation between ritual practice and persecution-response outcomes
axes.selection_reason: Contested kernel; all three readings proceed to generation as expansion of this single axis

axes.human_readable: Diaspora Synchronization Mechanism (Ritual Calendar as Coordination Technology)
axes.structural_delta: Fixed ritual calendar enables geographically dispersed communities to maintain synchronized practice without central authority
axes.primary_observable: Calendar adherence rates across diaspora communities; ritual timing variance; community cohesion metrics
axes.selection_reason: Independent observable (coordination mechanism vs memory content); structurally downstream; passes pairwise test against kernel

deferred_axes.structural_delta: Rabbinic interpretive layer absorbs contextual adaptation without surfacing as ritual revision
deferred_axes.deferral_reason: Captured within commitment_system_recognition drift_status=partial; interpretive mechanism rather than independent constraint axis

deferred_axes.structural_delta: Holocaust memory challenges traditional catastrophe-ritual framework (Yom HaShoah vs Tisha B'Av integration)
deferred_axes.deferral_reason: Temporal scope issue; 20th-century rupture is downstream consequence of kernel structure rather than independent axis; omega material for historical boundary question

omegas.description: How would survival-competence be measured independently of ritual practice? If competence is only observable through persecution-response outcomes, the adaptive_competence_reading may be unfalsifiable until catastrophe occurs.
omegas.source: Dark Matter Probe 1 (Operational Medium) + adaptive_competence_reading structural delta

omegas.description: Does Shoah memory integration (Yom HaShoah) validate or rupture the catastrophe-memory kernel? If traditional ritual framework cannot absorb industrial genocide, the kernel's adaptive claim weakens; if it absorbs via interpretive drift, the symbolic_continuity_reading strengthens.
omegas.source: Deferred axis shoah_commemoration_rupture + Absence Inventory (post-1945 ritual evolution)

omegas.description: Do secularized communities that abandon ritual practice lose survival-competence, or does competence transfer through non-ritual channels? Natural experiment in 20th-21st century diaspora.
omegas.source: Dark Matter Probe 3 (Beneficiary Scan) + symbolic_continuity_reading victim set

omegas.description: Hybrid_resilience_reading may collapse into symbolic_continuity if operational yield is unmeasurable. If survival-competence cannot be isolated from ritual practice, the three-reading structure reduces to two (symbolic vs adaptive) or one (symbolic only).

fracture_scan.notes: No fractures detected. Kernel structure cleanly identified; three readings are individually holdable and structurally distinct. Axiom contradiction declared between symbolic_continuity and adaptive_competence readings. Diaspora_synchronization_mechanism passes pairwise independence test (different observable: coordination technology vs memory content).
